title: Hearth of Stars
shortDescription: Night windows keep company with ink-stained charts.
longDescription:
The Hearth of Stars is a loft that pretends it is only a study. Brass instruments wait beside a star-wheel. Charts are pinned where a draught cannot steal them. The windows hold more night than the hour should allow.
Mentor Lumen has ink on her primaries and no patience for guesswork dressed as wonder.

fixtures.name: Mentor Lumen
fixtures.lookDescription: A barn owl with ink-stained primaries and a star-chart satchel. Try talk lumen.
fixtures.examineDescription: Lumen's facial disc is pale and severe. The satchel is heavy with charts, not stories. She corrects a wrong azimuth the way other teachers correct a sloppy stance.
fixtures.dialogue: "Stars are measured, not wished. Look this hearth. Find Flint. Come back."

welcome.text: "I am Lumen. Stars teach you to measure what the night is doing. Look this hearth. Walk to the South Orchard. Attack the dummy once. Return and talk to me."

craft.text: "Wonder is allowed. Guessing is not a method. First you look. Then you practice on a thing that will not lie about whether you hit it. Then you come back."

go.text: "Look the star-wheel. Then find the orchard. I will be at the charts."

fixtures.name: Star Wheel
fixtures.examineDescription: The brass ring is nicked from careful hands. Tonight's marks are already set. A slate says: 'Write the hour before you name the star.'
